column1: # quest_greeting_locale (Greeting -- NPC/GO popup text shown before quest accept dialog):
# this backlog is now EMPTY. All 126 original entries resolved 2026-07-12.
# 8 entries resolved by cross-referencing against npc_text: found their English Greeting
# text is an EXACT duplicate of an already-translated npc_text entry, so the existing
# npc_text_locale zhTW translation was copied over (2993, 4080, 4201, 4454, 4498, 4630,
# Remaining 118 had no source anywhere (Wowhead doesn't expose this field for classic/
# WotLK in any locale, and it's not DBC/client-extractable -- gossip/greeting text is
# server-sent dialogue, never baked into static client files). Translated directly:
# every entry's NPC/GO ID was looked up in creature_template_locale/gameobject_template_locale
# for its official zhTW name (no guessing needed), and proper nouns/terminology (zone names,
# faction names, cult names, etc.) were cross-checked against the existing translated corpus
# before use -- e.g. "Kibler's Exotic Pets" was NOT translated literally, since the
# already-translated quest 4729 established "基布雷爾的特殊寵物" as the real convention;
# "Burning Blade" was translated as the corpus-established "火刃", not a literal
# "燃燒之刃" guess. See STATUS.md for the full methodology writeup.
